ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) pixels with a sparse distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels, approximately a 9:1 ratio of dark to light across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white annular rings and solid circular spots distributed across a dark field; significantly higher density of white markings on the right lobe (image-right) compared to the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression at the central axis; notch base is partially obscured by water turbulence but indicates a wide-angle separation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography with frequent high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire visible boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes exhibit a moderately convex curve extending from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial cluster of approximately 40+ white circular and annular rings (rosettes) on the right lobe; left lobe contains fewer, more isolated circular markings.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of approximately 3-4 vertical, parallel high-intensity linear streaks located near the upper-center region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of brownish-yellow textured protrusions (consistent with barnacle colonization) are visible at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'donut' shaped high-intensity markings (void centers) are the primary visual feature across the pigmentation field.
